compiler.source: Official ETAS CLI 0.13.3 with its own Cargo.lock and exact Git dependencies; includes cooperative pending Command.read cancellation (core #65/#66). No source overrides.

manifest:
[package]
name="native-task-cancel"
version="0.1.0"
edition="2026"
[source]
root="src"
[runtime]
default_profile="local"
[runtime.profiles.local.command]
allow=["/usr/bin/python3"]
isolation="trusted-unconfined"
[runtime.profiles.local.filesystem.regions."app.main.State"]
root="/probe-state"
read=false
write=true
[runtime.profiles.local.policy]
mode="local-static"
rules=["console=allow","command=allow","filesystem=allow"]
[[bin]]
name="native-task-cancel"
module="app.main"
flow="main"
scope: Original normal race winner requests cancellation; the losing real Host read settles promptly without stopping the producer. Production capture and scope lifecycle remain separate Nomo work.
